description: This file defines a controller class for handling 'terms' related web requests in a Perl web application, including actions for listing and showing individual terms, with navigation to previous and next terms.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Terms
classes.description: Controller class for handling 'terms' related web requests, extending Coocook::Controller with specific actions for listing and showing terms.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list the current valid terms and redirects to the 'show' action for the first valid term.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to display a specific term by ID, including navigation links to previous and next terms.
